prose: Basis: the Techmeme summary of the piece; the Bloomberg profile itself could not be fetched. Bloomberg profiles Blackstone president Jon Gray, who has made AI the firm's biggest bet - building a $200B data center empire and launching a cloud venture with Google.
Per the summary, AI runs through everything at the alternative-investment giant, from data centers and chip financing to AI advice on potential deals.
